title: Publish complete artifact directories without replacing destinations

context.use: Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.
Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.

outcome: Run and comparison publication is atomic with respect to destination existence and never overwrites inputs.

artifacts.purpose: Temporary sibling publication and cleanup tests

interfaces: Input: complete serialized result and snapshot/evidence bytes; output: immutable destination plus exact result file digest.
Temporary sibling and host-supported no-replace operation are required; ordinary exists-then-rename is forbidden.
Filesystem failures stay typed; no retry/fallback publication mode.
acceptance_criteria: A racing destination creator wins safely: existing file/directory/symlink remains unchanged and publication fails.
Validation or injected late write failure leaves no final success directory; cleanup handles only owned temporary artifacts.
On the tested host, run directory permissions protect full snapshots and receipt paths are absolute.

verification.expected: Concurrent destination creation cannot be overwritten.
No final result after injected write failure; source bytes unchanged.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
